board.name: Michigan Task Force on Physician's Assistants (LARA Bureau of Professional Licensing)

licence.title: Physician's Assistant
licence.renewalDeadline: Licence expiration date; renewal opens 90 days before; 60 day grace period with late fee

ce.categoryRules: No general CE required for renewal

topicMandates.appliesTo: all PAs (1 hour for each year of the 3 year cycle; no carry forward)

topicMandates.topic: Opioids and controlled substances awareness (MAPS use; state and federal prescribing law)
topicMandates.appliesTo: PAs holding or applying for a Michigan controlled substance licence (R 338.3135(1)-(4))
topicMandates.reason: R 338.3135(1) requires completion before applying for or renewing a CS licence and the LARA guide requires certifying completion at renewal; neither states one-time or every renewal for PAs (subrule (5)'s once-per-cycle applies to delegatees other than PAs).

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: R 338.3135 opioid and controlled substances awareness training before applying for or renewing the controlled substance licence; no hour count

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Practice agreement with a participating physician, signed by both, with a 30 day written termination provision; the statute lists contents only and sets no filing with LARA or periodic renewal
practice.notes: Practice agreement replaced delegation/supervision effective March 22, 2017 (2016 PA 379). Agreement must include communication and decision making process, alternate physician protocol, duties, and physician verification of PA credentials.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Michigan controlled substance licence (applied with or after the PA licence) plus DEA
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: Opioids and controlled substances awareness training (R 338.3135)

facts.value: 3 years
facts.quote: PA licenses are valid for 3 years.

facts.value: No CE required
facts.cite: LARA PA Licensing Guide FAQ; R 338.6311
facts.quote: Currently Michigan statute and administrative rules do not require continuing education for renewal.

facts.value: One-time human trafficking training
facts.quote: they have completed a one-time training in identifying victims of human trafficking that meets the standards in Administrative Rule 338.6103.

facts.value: 1 hour per year of the licence cycle, every renewal
facts.quote: shall have completed a minimum of 1 hour of implicit bias training for each year of the applicant's license or registration cycle.

facts.value: No carry forward between cycles
facts.quote: A licensee or registrant shall not carry forward implicit bias training hours earned during 1 renewal cycle to the next renewal cycle.

facts.value: Training required before applying for or renewing a CS licence (topics: MAPS use; state and federal prescribing law); PAs are subject to subrules (1), (3), (4); no hours; repeat interval not stated
facts.quote: An individual who is applying for or renewing a controlled substance license shall complete a training in opioids and controlled substances awareness

facts.value: Separate Michigan controlled substance licence
facts.quote: you must apply for both a physician's assistant and controlled substance license.

facts.value: Practice agreement required
facts.quote: A physician's assistant shall not engage in the practice as a physician's assistant except under the terms of a practice agreement

facts.value: 30 day written termination provision
facts.quote: terminate the practice agreement by providing written notice at least 30 days before the date of termination.

facts.value: 60 day grace period with late fee
facts.quote: there is a 60-day grace period in which you may renew your license without having to go through the relicensure process.

facts.value: PAs follow R 338.3135(1),(3),(4), not the delegatee once-per-cycle subrule (5)
facts.quote: A physician’s assistant is subject to subrules (1), (3), and (4) of this rule.

facts.value: Implicit bias is not one-time; required each renewal cycle
facts.quote: this is not a one-time training and must be completed for each renewal cycle prior to the renewal being completed.

facts.value: PA renewal rule sets no CE; only code, rules, fee and application
facts.quote: An applicant for license renewal shall satisfy the requirements of the code and the rules promulgated under the code

board.name: Michigan Board of Nursing (LARA Bureau of Professional Licensing)

rn.nlcNote: HB 4246 (Nurse Licensure Compact) passed the House 6/11/2025 and was referred to the Senate Regulatory Affairs committee; not enacted

topicMandates.appliesTo: all RNs (1 hour per year of the 2 year cycle; may also count toward CE)
all RNs (one-time; certified at renewal per LARA nursing guide)

aprn.title: RN with Nurse Practitioner specialty certification (APRN)
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: Specialty certification on the Michigan RN licence

topicMandates.topic: Opioids and controlled substances awareness (8 listed topics including MAPS, pain alternatives, stigma, disposal)
topicMandates.appliesTo: APRNs prescribing controlled substances as a physician's delegatee (taken 1 time during each current licence cycle)

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: None for nonscheduled drugs; schedules 2 to 5 only as a delegated act of a physician with a written delegation agreement; APRNs get no Michigan CS licence, only DEA
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: R 338.3135(5) training once in each current licence cycle for delegatees

practice.agreementType: physician delegation (written delegation agreement) for controlled substances only
practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: No collaborative agreement for nonscheduled prescribing (MCL 333.17211a). For schedules 2 to 5 the delegating physician's written authorization (names, licence numbers, signatures, limits, effective date) is reviewed and updated annually, kept at the physician's primary place of practice, and a copy given to the NP; it is not filed with LARA (R 338.2411). Controlled substance prescriptions carry both names and DEA numbers.
practice.authorityNote: 'restricted' is a classification label, not a primary source term; statute allows independent nonscheduled prescribing and delegated schedules 2 to 5.

facts.value: 2 years
facts.quote: Renewal Cycle: 2 years

facts.value: 25 hours in the 2 years before expiration
facts.quote: shall accumulate not less than 25 hours of continuing education that are approved by the board under these rules

facts.value: 2 of the 25 hours in pain and symptom management each renewal
facts.quote: shall complete not less than 2 hours of the 25 required hours, of continuing education in pain and pain symptom management in each renewal period

facts.value: 1 hour per year of the cycle
facts.quote: shall have completed a minimum of 1 hour of implicit bias training for each year of the applicant's license or registration cycle.

facts.value: One-time human trafficking training (certified at renewal)
facts.quote: they have completed a one-time training in identifying victims of human trafficking that meets the standards in Administrative Rule 338.10105.

facts.value: Not a member; HB 4246 pending in Senate committee
facts.quote: REFERRED TO COMMITTEE ON REGULATORY AFFAIRS

facts.value: Specialty certification renews on the RN schedule
facts.quote: Specialty certification renewal must correspond with the same schedule as the license renewal.

facts.value: National certification maintained within the 2 years before renewal
facts.quote: shall have obtained recertification or maintained certification within the 2-year period immediately before the application

facts.value: Nonscheduled drugs independently; schedules 2 to 5 as physician delegated act
facts.quote: a controlled substance included in schedules 2 to 5 of part 72, as a delegated act of a physician.

facts.value: No Michigan CS licence for APRNs; DEA only
facts.quote: APRNs do not get their own CS license

facts.value: Written delegation agreement for controlled substances
facts.cite: LARA Nursing Licensing Guide FAQ; R 338.2411
facts.quote: there must be a written delegation agreement between the APRN and the doctor when dealing with controlled substances.

facts.value: Delegatee CS training once during each current licence cycle
facts.quote: The training must be taken 1 time during the current license cycle

facts.value: Physician's written authorization delegating schedule 2 to 5 prescribing to an NP must state limits and effective date
facts.quote: if the delegating physician establishes a written authorization that has all the following information

facts.value: Written authorization reviewed and updated annually; review date noted on it
facts.quote: The delegating physician shall review and update a written authorization on an annual basis after the original date or the date of amendment

facts.value: Kept at the delegating physician's primary place of practice; copy to the NP; not filed with LARA
facts.quote: The delegating physician shall maintain a written authorization at the delegating physician’s primary place of practice.

facts.value: 25 hours apply to a nurse licensed for the full 2 years before expiration
facts.quote: an applicant for license renewal who has been licensed for the 2-year period immediately before the expiration date of the license

facts.value: A renewing nurse who also applies for a CS licence completes a 1-time opioid and CS awareness training
facts.quote: shall complete a 1-time training in opioids and other controlled substances awareness as required in R 338.3135.

unverified: PA opioid/CS awareness training repeat interval: R 338.3135(1) (as amended, eff. May 28, 2024) requires completion before applying for or renewing a CS licence, and the LARA PA guide requires certifying completion at renewal; neither says one-time or every renewal.
MI NP practice authority label 'restricted' is a classification, not a primary source term.
Exact MI RN and PA expiration dates (fixed calendar date vs licence anniversary) were not found in loaded LARA pages; renewal opens about 90 days before the licence expiration date.
No Michigan pharmacology CE requirement for NPs was found in R 338.10601 to 338.10602 or R 338.10405b; this is absence by reading of the rules.

corrections: PA: opioid/CS awareness training period changed from 'every cycle' to 'unverified' with the reason; R 338.3135(2) (added as a fact) shows PAs fall under subrules (1),(3),(4), and neither the rule nor the LARA guide states the repeat interval.
PA: added LARA guide quote that implicit bias is not one-time and is due each renewal cycle; added R 338.6311 confirming no CE in the PA renewal rule.

NP: added missed Board of Medicine rule R 338.2411: written delegation authorization for schedule 2 to 5 must be reviewed and updated annually, kept at the delegating physician's primary place of practice, copy to the NP; the researcher had 'filing rule ... not found'. Agreement filing/renewal text rewritten.
NP: human trafficking training now cited to the LARA nursing guide, which states 'one-time' explicitly (R 338.10105 alone does not say one-time).
NP: added R 338.10601(1) full-cycle condition for the 25 hours and R 338.10601(3) 1-time CS training for a renewing nurse who also applies for a CS licence.
